_doc: Owner 2026-11-24 decision 2A (scope: every automatic check of the animation skill): a life metric blocks only with a calibration proof. Written ONLY by `python life_calibrate.py --write-gate` after a COMPLETE run (CALIB: OK, every clip of life_calibration.json present): a metric is listed when every expect=PASS clip (stock + approved) passes it and at least one expect=FAIL clip fails it. Never edited by hand (tests/test_life.py checks every row has its proof). Metrics not listed are measures shown to the reviewer as 'WOULD FAIL ...'. hold_reason is a declaration rule and blocks without proof.
